text:
morgan: FYI customer Acme reported elevated latencies — their requests are being routed to us-east despite asking for EU. trace id: rtr-20260301-9a1b

morgan: Attached sample header we got from their SDK (copied raw):
```
X-Client-Region: ​eu
User-Agent: AcmeMobile/2.3
Accept: application/json
```

ingrid: :eyes: That looks like a zero-width space (ZWSP) before 'eu'. Could the SDK be adding it during string concat? Any client version info?

morgan: They reported mobile SDK 2.3.1. Repro steps from their engineer: 
```
# note the invisible char after the colon in the header above
curl -i -H "X-Client-Region: ​eu" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
response shows hits at us-east node (rtr-20260301-9a1b) and p95 latency ~220ms.

leo: Confirmed: the router's header matching is currently exact-string after case normalization, but we don't trim Unicode whitespace. A ZWSP will cause mismatch -> fallback to default region -> us-east. Likely root cause.

nisha: Can we patch the router to trim Unicode whitespace (ZWSP, NBSP, BOM) from X-Client-Region and region query param? Also recommend an edge rule as a quick mitigation.

ingrid: Quick edge normalization sounds good. Any risk to existing traffic?

leo: Low risk. We already canonicalize case and strip ASCII whitespace for a few headers. Adding a unicode-aware trim for this single header should be safe. I'll prepare a small PR and a canary deploy. Also suggest we emit a metric for "region_header_unexpected_chars" to quantify.

morgan: Customer is worried about billing — tokens routed via us-east are billed at their default tier. If misroute confirmed, they want credit for the delta.

nisha: If we confirm misroute due to client header ZWSP, support should offer a one-time credit and note the incident. I'll loop in finance and CS.

routing-bot: deploy scheduled: edge-rule-normalize-region-header v1 -> canary window starting 2167890500, full rollout 2167890600.

morgan: I'll reply to the customer with repro steps and a temporary client-side workaround (strip invisible chars before sending). Also cc @ingrid @leo for follow-up.

ingrid: I'll add unit tests covering ZWSP, NBSP, BOM and a small e2e that confirms normalized header routes to eu-west.

leo: MR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/router/merge_requests/482 — includes Unicode trim + metric + changelog. Planning canary after CI passes.

morgan: Thanks. Once canary looks good we'll confirm routing telemetry and then process credit. Will update thread.
